system.name: Teola
system.one_liner: an orchestration framework for LLM-based applications that represents each query as a primitive-level dataflow graph for fine-grained scheduling

content.subject: how Teola's graph optimizer parallelizes and pipelines a RAG query's primitive-level dataflow graph across four numbered optimization passes

elements.name: Input: Docs
elements.role: raw documents entering the indexing pipeline

elements.name: Input: Question
elements.role: the user's question entering the query-expansion/retrieval pipeline

elements.name: Embedding
elements.role: computes an embedding for a document chunk or a query

elements.name: Ingestion
elements.role: ingests embedded document chunks into the index

elements.name: In-place Aggregate
elements.role: aggregates partial outputs (embeddings, or reranked/refined results) in place

elements.name: LLM Prefilling
elements.role: prefills the LLM's KV cache for the question-expansion prompt

elements.name: PD0
elements.role: partial-decode primitive streaming out the first expanded query

elements.name: Searching
elements.role: retrieves candidate chunks for one expanded query

elements.name: Reranking
elements.role: reranks retrieved chunks for one expanded query

elements.name: Partial Prefilling
elements.role: prefills only the new refine-instruction/context part of a prompt, reusing prior KV cache

elements.name: Full Prefilling
elements.role: prefills an entire prompt when no reusable KV cache exists

elements.name: LLM Decoding
elements.role: decodes the LLM's answer given a prefilled prompt

elements.name: Pass 1
elements.role: optimization pass that pipelines document ingestion with query processing

elements.name: Pass 2
elements.role: optimization pass that splits embedding/ingestion into per-chunk-batch pieces

elements.name: Pass 3
elements.role: optimization pass that streams partial decoding output into subsequent primitives, applied at multiple points

elements.name: Pass 4
elements.role: optimization pass that parallelizes the expanded queries' search/rerank across separate branches

elements.name: Data dependency
elements.role: legend entry for the plain arrow denoting a data-dependency edge

relations.what: documents are embedded per chunk batch
chunk embeddings are ingested into the index
ingested chunk batches are aggregated in place, pipelined with query processing
the question, with a QA instruction, is prefilled for query expansion
partial decoding streams out an expanded query as soon as it is available
the streamed new query is searched against the index without waiting for full decoding
retrieved chunks for one expanded query are reranked
the top reranked chunk with a QA instruction is fully prefilled for the initial candidate answer
the candidate answer plus a refine instruction and the next chunk's context are partially prefilled, reusing prior KV cache

steps.what: pipelines document ingestion so indexing overlaps with query processing instead of running to completion first
splits embeddings into smaller per-chunk-batch pieces so they can be processed and aggregated incrementally
streams partial decoding output (an expanded query, or a refined answer) directly into the next primitive instead of waiting for full decoding to finish
parallelizes the three expanded queries' searching and reranking across separate branches (PD0/PD1/PD2)

content.key_idea: Representing a query as a primitive-level dataflow graph lets Teola's optimizer apply targeted rewrite passes, splitting, pipelining, and parallelizing individual primitives like embedding, prefilling, and decoding, that a coarser task-level orchestrator could never expose.
content.reading_order: top-left Input: Docs through the embedding/ingestion pipeline (Pass 1, Pass 2), then bottom-left Input: Question through LLM Prefilling splitting into parallel expanded-query branches (Pass 3, Pass 4) with Searching/Reranking, converging into the refine-mode LLM synthesis chain on the right (Partial/Full Prefilling and LLM Decoding, repeating Pass 3) toward the final candidate answer

summary: This figure walks through an optimized primitive-level execution graph (e-graph) that Teola's graph optimizer produces for one advanced RAG query with a refine-mode synthesizer. Documents flow through Embedding and Ingestion primitives (Pass 2 splits this into per-chunk-batch pieces, Pass 1 pipelines it with query processing via In-place Aggregate), while the question is expanded by LLM Prefilling into three new queries, streamed out via partial decoding (Pass 3) before full decoding finishes. Each expanded query's Searching and Reranking runs in its own parallel branch (Pass 4), and the top-ranked chunk feeds a QA-style Full Prefilling and LLM Decoding to produce an initial candidate answer, which is then refined twice more: each refinement partially prefills just the new instruction and context (reusing the prior KV cache, another instance of Pass 3) before a full prefilling and decoding step yields the next candidate answer. Overlaid 'Pass 1' through 'Pass 4' labels on dashed boxes tie each optimization directly to the subgraph it rewrites, illustrating how fine-grained, primitive-level graph optimization exposes parallelization and pipelining opportunities a coarser, module-level orchestrator would miss.
summary_zh: 该图展示Teola图优化器为一个高级RAG（refine模式）查询生成的优化后原语级执行图：文档经Embedding/Ingestion（Pass2按批拆分，Pass1与查询流程流水线化）；问题经LLM Prefilling扩展为三条新查询并流式输出（Pass3），各自并行Searching/Reranking（Pass4），最终经Prefilling/Decoding多轮精炼生成候选答案，Pass标签标出各优化对应的子图。
